start: Settings, Your data, Backup and restore, a phone with workouts and a MettleUp backup ZIP saved in Files; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With saved data saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Restore from a backup file".
user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

user_sees: 'Choose a backup file made by MettleUp or the old ForgeAI app. You see what is inside before anything changes.'
Button 'Choose backup file'
must_not: Anything on the phone changed before a file is chosen

steps.action: Tap 'Choose backup file' and pick the mettleup-backup ZIP
user_sees: Heading 'In this backup'
A summary such as '512 workouts, 9 routines, 40 measurements and 12 photos, saved on 25 Oct 2026 by MettleUp ...'
Buttons 'Replace everything on this phone', 'Add to what's here', 'Choose another file'
must_not: Any workout, routine or setting changed just by opening the file

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Delete N workouts first?' saying the phone's workouts go, how many are not in the backup, and 'A copy is kept while you stay on this screen, so you can undo.'
Button 'Replace'
must_not: The phone's workouts deleted before 'Replace' is tapped

user_sees: 'Putting back 3 of 12 photos...', then 'Putting back your workouts and routines...', then 'Working out your records...'
'Restored N workouts, N routines, N measurements and N photos.'
Button 'Undo restore'
must_not: The phone number or gym link replaced from the file
A half-restored phone when a step fails
Photos already on the phone deleted
Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

note: Files from ForgeAI 0.55.2 and older formats must open; newer format refused with NEWER_BACKUP

user_sees: The request goes through the longest-serving address of ours; a harmless test call checks the newer one in the background
must_not: The member's request sent to an unproven address

steps.action: Lock the phone at step 1 of "Reaching the server when Supabase is blocked", wait two minutes, unlock.
user_sees: The same screen with the same typed values
must_not: A lost draft of saved data, a timer or count that stopped, or a sign-out with no reason given

note: No internet at all looks like 'our address failed' and rests good addresses; after coming back online requests go direct until the rest ends
